title: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis, version 4 (GISTEMP v4)
owner: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies
what: The map, the tap card and the year row: the 1 200 km Land-Ocean Temperature Index on a 2° grid (gistemp1200_GHCNv4_ERSSTv5.nc.gz). The stripes and the global means: GISS's own table (GLB.Ts+dSST.csv).
via: the grid: Internet Archive capture 20260906203026 of https://data.giss.nasa.gov/pub/gistemp/gistemp1200_GHCNv4_ERSSTv5.nc.gz
the table: Internet Archive capture 20260914070505 of https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/tabledata_v4/GLB.Ts+dSST.csv
licence: Public domain in the United States (US Government work, 17 U.S.C. §105); GISS asks for a citation of the page (with the access date) and of its most recent paper
attribution: Temperature: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4); annual means and 0.1 °C rounding by this app.
citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. Dataset accessed 2026-10-01 at https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/.

Lenssen, N., G.A. Schmidt, M. Hendrickson, P. Jacobs, M. Menne, and R. Ruedy, 2024: A GISTEMPv4 observational uncertainty ensemble. J. Geophys. Res. Atmos., 129, no. 17, e2023JD040179, doi:10.1029/2023JD040179.
changes: Annual means of each 2° cell (a year needs 9 of its 12 months; the partial year three quarters of its published months), rounded to 0.1 °C half away from zero; rows reordered north first; the newest 24 months rounded to 0.1 °C. Nothing interpolated or filled.
endorsement: NASA does not endorse this app. It uses NASA's published data, as NASA's media guidelines allow for factual use. No NASA insignia or logotype is used.
inputs: Menne, M. J., C. N. Williams, B.E. Gleason, J. J Rennie, and J. H. Lawrimore, 2018: The Global Historical Climatology Network Monthly Temperature Dataset, Version 4. J. Climate, 31, 9835-9854, doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-18-0094.1.

Boyin Huang, Peter W. Thorne, Viva F. Banzon, Tim Boyer, Gennady Chepurin, Jay H. Lawrimore, Matthew J. Menne, Thomas M. Smith, Russell S. Vose, and Huai-Min Zhang (2017): NOAA Extended Reconstructed Sea Surface Temperature (ERSST), Version 5. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. doi:10.7289/V5T72FNM.
Hansen, J., R. Ruedy, M. Sato, and K. Lo, 2010: Global surface temperature change. Rev. Geophys., 48, RG4004, doi:10.1029/2010RG000345.
